title: Fixed early HARPS waves reduce HIRES error for Kapteyn's star by 31.7 percent, but three resampling ranges include zero
abstract: We test fixed waves at the reported 48.616-day and 121.54-day Kapteyn periods on a separate instrument. A fit to 48 early HARPS nights reduces squared error in 31 HIRES nights by 31.7 percent. Resampling both inputs in 30-day bins gives a 95 percent range from -13.1 to +54.5 percent. Ranges for 120-day and 365-day bins also include zero. Nine weight and instrument controls give positive point scores. All 441 nearby period pairs give positive scores. The target observations overlap the early HARPS era. HIRES helped select the published periods, so this is not a blind validation. A shared early stellar signal or a stable orbit mixed with activity can explain the result. Neither planet is confirmed. Code, source hashes, retrieval steps, aggregate results and a figure are included. External observation tables are not bundled.
